title: A grade described in words
evaluator_sees: the fixture frame and the graded frame at the same time
the effect stack on the graded layer

criteria.question: Does the frame read as the look the person asked for?

anchors.1: Partly; a colourist would push it further or pull it back

criteria.question: Are neutrals and skin-like patches believable, with no colour cast beyond the brief?
Are shadows and highlights handled as asked, without milky blacks or crushed detail?
Is the grade made of live, named, adjustable effects a colourist could keep working with?
